# Keshav Enterprises

> Ex-OEM steam turbine engineers providing overhauling, reverse engineering, dynamic balancing, lube oil flushing, machine alignment, and OEM-compatible spares for 5 kW–60 MW turbines. Based in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh, India. 24×7 emergency breakdown response. Founder Shekhar Sharma has worked hands-on with steam turbines since 1988 (38+ years of engineering experience); he started an independent turbine maintenance partnership in 2016, and Keshav Enterprises was formally established in June 2020.

Keshav Enterprises serves steam turbines from 5 kW to 60 MW (both back-pressure and condensing types, single or multi-stage, horizontal or vertical) across 7 industry sectors: Power Generation, Sugar Mills & Distilleries, Paper & Pulp Mills, Oil & Gas Industries, Petrochemical & Refineries, Agro & Food Processing, Cement & Steel Plants. The engineering team includes ex-OEM specialists from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, Chola Turbo, DLF-Skoda, KKK, ABB. More than 500 overhauls completed.

- [About](https://keshavturbotech.com/about): Company history, timeline, team, OEM expertise, and export credentials (IEC registered, GST 09BOSPS3115K1ZC, MSME UDYAM-UP-47-0071234).

## Services (8)

- [Turbine Erection & Commissioning](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/turbine-erection-and-commissioning): Expert erection and commissioning for steam turbines, pumps, compressors, fans, condensers, EOT cranes, and steam/water/air pipeline work. Includes complete OEM coordination and documentation.
- [Turnkey Overhauling & Maintenance](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/turnkey-overhauling-and-maintenance): Executed by ex-OEM engineers from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss, and more. Includes pre-shutdown planning, on-site condition reporting, comprehensive spares management, and 24x7 emergency troubleshooting.
- [Precision Reverse Engineering](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/precision-reverse-engineering): PMI-verified reverse engineering using 3D laser scanners, CMM, and copying lathes for turbines from 5 kW to 60 MW. Generate full manufacturing drawings with tolerances, concentricity, pre/post heat treatment specs.
- [Dynamic Balancing & Rotor Machining](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/dynamic-balancing-and-rotor-machining): Precision rotor machining (grinding, polishing, journal undersizing) at our workshop lathes, plus ISO/API standard dynamic balancing from 50 to 2000 kg with full compliance reporting.
- [Lube Oil Flushing](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/lube-oil-flushing): ISO-compliant flushing using purpose-built mobile centrifuge filter systems. Achieves maximum cleanliness and de-watering following construction or during scheduled maintenance.
- [Machine Alignment](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/machine-alignment): Expert machine alignment using latest technology to eliminate misalignment, one of the primary causes of equipment failure. Covers turbines, gearboxes, pumps, fans, alternators, and induction generators.
- [Troubleshooting Service](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/troubleshooting-service): Rapid on-site fault diagnosis for steam turbines experiencing vibration, bearing failure, governor instability, steam leakage, oil contamination, or unexpected trips. Ex-OEM engineers deploy with full diagnostic instrumentation for root-cause identification and corrective action.
- [Sand Blasting & Surface Preparation](https://keshavturbotech.com/services/sand-blasting-and-surface-preparation): Controlled abrasive blasting for turbine rotors, casings, and components, removing rust, scale, and old coatings ahead of inspection, reverse engineering, or recoating without damaging critical machined surfaces.

## Industries Served (7)

- [Power Generation](https://keshavturbotech.com/industries/power-generation): Supplying critical overhauling services and OEM-compatible spares to thermal power plants operating steam turbines from 5 MW to 60 MW. Our ex-OEM engineers ensure maximum plant availability.
- [Sugar Mills & Distilleries](https://keshavturbotech.com/industries/sugar-mills-and-distilleries): Serving India's sugar industry with specialized back-pressure steam turbine services. Scheduled overhauling during off-season and emergency breakdown support during crushing season.
- [Paper & Pulp Mills](https://keshavturbotech.com/industries/paper-and-pulp-mills): Paper mills operate steam turbines continuously and require precision maintenance to maintain uptime. We provide planned shutdown overhauling and critical spare components.
- [Oil & Gas Industries](https://keshavturbotech.com/industries/oil-and-gas-industries): Oil and gas facilities demand the highest standards of precision engineering for turbine-driven compressors and pumps. Our API-compliant products meet the stringent requirements of upstream and downstream facilities.
- [Petrochemical & Refineries](https://keshavturbotech.com/industries/petrochemical-and-refineries): Petrochemical and refinery turbines run continuously in hazardous environments, requiring API-grade filtration, explosion-proof instrumentation, and certified sealing products.
- [Agro & Food Processing](https://keshavturbotech.com/industries/agro-and-food-processing): Agro-industrial facilities including rice mills, cotton gins, and food processing plants rely on back-pressure steam turbines for power and process steam. We provide cost-effective overhauling, spares, and fitration products.
- [Cement & Steel Plants](https://keshavturbotech.com/industries/cement-and-steel-plants): Cement and steel plants operate large multi-stage steam turbines and require high-reliability maintenance with minimum production disruption. We provide planned and emergency overhauling services.
